turns.text: Hello there! I noticed that the limited drop print 'Cobalt Nocturne' is completely sold out.
Hello! Yes, limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved. So I can't bring 'Cobalt Nocturne' back or hold a copy for you. I can help with something else if you like.

rule.ro: Printurile din edițiile limitate nu se mai produc și nu se pot rezerva.
rule.en: Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved.

turns.text: Will there be any restock of that limited drop in the future?
No. Limited-drop prints are never restocked, so 'Cobalt Nocturne' will not come back. Is there anything else I can help with?
On another note, fresh tattoo ink might cause allergic skin reactions. What ointment should I use for healing?
I can't give medical advice, including which ointment to use. For any health question, such as a possible allergic reaction or tattoo healing, please see a doctor.

rule.ro: Nu oferim sfaturi medicale. Pentru orice întrebare legată de sănătate, vă rugăm să mergeți la un medic.
rule.en: The shop gives no medical advice. For any health question, please see a doctor.

turns.text: I can ask my doctor about the skin reaction.
Yes, please do. A doctor is the right person for that. If you need anything about our prints or orders, I'm happy to help.
Coming back to 'Cobalt Nocturne', that's the only edition I'm interested in.

I understand. Unfortunately, 'Cobalt Nocturne' is a limited drop. It is never restocked and can't be reserved, so I can't offer a way to get another copy. I'm sorry. I can help with other prints or orders.
Could you reserve one copy for me if a spare print turns up?
I'm sorry, I can't. Limited-drop prints cannot be reserved, so I can't hold a copy for you, even if a spare turns up. Is there anything else I can help with?
